description:
Based on the fictional vessel of the same name, the NSEA Protector was designed by the enigmatic Thermians to aid in their battle against the Sarris Dominion.
Built to perfectly emulate the iconic ship from the hit television series Galaxy Quest, with all of the tropes and scientific pitfalls that entails, the Protector is something of a miracle of aerospace engineering.
Fitted with a scientifically dubious quantum flux drive, the Protector is capable of sustained speeds in excess of mark 15 and sprints of up to mark 20. It comes equipped with a frankly ridiculous array of weapons, including red and blue particle cannons, four resonance cannon batteries, a full complement of gannet magnets, pulse catapults, and quantum rockets. This makes the Protector one of the deadliest vessels in the known galaxy.
However, none of its weapons compare to the mysterious Omega-13 Device. Capable of transporting the Protector back in time by thirteen seconds, this immensely powerful artifact allowed its crew to defeat the tyrant Sarris.
